delete.title: Delete {name}’s account?
delete.removesDriver: This permanently removes their sign-in, contact details, vehicle link and location history. It can’t be undone.
delete.removesOperator: This permanently removes their sign-in and contact details. It can’t be undone.
delete.keptDriver: Past deliveries, proof of delivery and COD records are kept and still show their name.
delete.keptOperator: Past actions in the activity log are kept and still show their name.
delete.driverBlocked: A driver with deliveries in progress or unreconciled cash can’t be deleted until those are dealt with.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: One active rule per account type and service. Every booking is priced — and re-checked by the database — with it.
pricing.activateBody: New bookings for this account type and service are priced with it immediately. Existing shipments keep their original price.

form.name: Rule name

form.makeActive: Make this the active rule for {account} · {service}
form.neverEdited: Rules are never edited in place — existing shipments keep the rule they were priced under.
form.savedActive: Saved and activated — new bookings use it now.
form.saved: Saved. Activate it from the history below.

settings.title: Settings

supabase.name: Supabase
supabase.detail: Database, auth, storage and realtime. The service-role key is required for staff onboarding.

mapboxPublic.name: Mapbox (map display)
mapboxPublic.detail: Public token for rendering maps in the browser. Restrict it to your domains in Mapbox.

mapboxSecret.name: Mapbox (routing & geocoding)
mapboxSecret.detail: Server-only token. Pricing depends on it — without it no booking can be priced.

turnstile.name: Bot protection (Cloudflare Turnstile)
turnstile.detail: Protects sign-in, registration, password reset and tracking. Without it, production refuses those requests.
turnstile.disabled: Explicitly disabled (TURNSTILE_DISABLED=true). Sign-in and tracking rely on rate limiting alone.

payments.name: Payment provider
payments.detail: Not connected. Card bookings are saved as pending payment until a provider is implemented in lib/payments.

sms.name: SMS provider
sms.detail: Not connected. Delivery OTPs are sent to the customer’s in-app notifications instead.

settings.managersBody: For security, manager accounts can’t be created or removed from inside the app — the database blocks it from every application session. Add or remove managers from the Supabase dashboard (see README, “Creating a manager”).
